entry.title: glibc's header-defined `__bswap_16/32/64` and `__uint64_identity` carry 599 uncontracted-call leaves and were deliberately not declared
entry.why: Card W43-LIBC-CONTRACTS classified them `libc-inline`: each is `static __inline` with its body in a glibc header inside every unit that uses it (`bits/byteswap.h`, `bits/uintn-identity.h`), so a name-keyed contract would replace a checkable body with a trusted assumption, and there is no extern prototype for the declared-ABI gate. They block 87, 84, 33 and 1 functions, 0 of them solely. Discharge condition: model `__builtin_bswap16/32/64` (scalar builtins) so W4 can derive the header bodies, or a recorded decision to contract header-inline libc bodies.

ground: Its discharge condition admits 'a recorded decision to contract header-inline libc bodies'. Card W44-LIBC-RESIDUALS recorded that decision and declared all six helpers the analysed units call from main source (__bswap_16/32/64, __uint16/32/64_identity) in the new providers/quirin-provider-libc/contracts/libc/byteswap.qcore as the neutral element, stating them as header-inline bodies; the census finds one (signature, body) pair per helper across all 174 defining units, each pure arithmetic over its one scalar parameter. __bswap_64 was unreadable to the declared-ABI reader because of `__extension__`, which the reader now discards (Lean: QCore.GnuBuiltinReader); all six agree in 174/174 units. Arbiter stage 2: the 599 header-inline callee leaves removed, 27 newly-safe-callee leaves and 1 nested leaf removed, 5 added (formal in an unmodeled expression), all attributed; ut_put_be16/32/64 Unknown -> Safe relative to the declared premises. The unchecked body is registered as W44-HEADER-INLINE-BODY-UNCHECKED. docs/reports/w44-libc-residuals/README.md.

entry.title: The `va_list` printf members (`vsnprintf`, `vprintf`, `vfprintf`, `vsprintf`) are refused by name: the declared-ABI reader cannot read `__gnuc_va_list`
entry.why: Card W43-LIBC-PRINTF-FAMILY declared printf, fprintf, snprintf and sprintf and ran the same declared-ABI census over the four va_list members (docs/reports/w43-libc-printf-family/census/family9.txt): each is withdrawn with `abi-unreadable-declaration` in all 168 units that declare it, because its last parameter is `__gnuc_va_list __arg`, a typedef of the compiler builtin `__builtin_va_list` that `legacy_declared_abi::resolve_typedef` cannot resolve, and the v1 ABI projection has no spelling for it (on x86-64 it is `__va_list_tag[1]`, which decays to an object pointer in a parameter; on AArch64 it is a struct passed by value, so a pointer spelling would be target-bound). A declaration withdrawn everywhere decides nothing and only renames leaves, so none is shipped. Measured cost at the card's AFTER: `vsnprintf` 25 leaves in 25 functions and `vprintf` 1 leaf (`mk_print`); `vfprintf` and `vsprintf` are not called. All 26 of those functions carry other reasons (24 of them a `__builtin_va_start`/`__builtin_va_end` leaf), so no function is sole-blocked and the function yield of a repair alone is zero. Discharge condition: a reader spelling for `__builtin_va_list` (target-bound, with the LOADER-ABI-LP64 caveat stated) with matching audited Lean and a re-measured census, together with a model of the `va_start`/`va_end` builtins if movement is wanted; or this refusal kept as a measured boundary.

ground: Its discharge condition is a reader spelling for __builtin_va_list with matching audited Lean and a re-measured census. Card W44-LIBC-RESIDUALS added the loader spelling `va_list` (parameter-only, not a ptr spelling, so borrowed-only; target-independent: it names the type, not its representation) and taught the declared-ABI reader to project the builtin, reached through __gnuc_va_list, to it at a parameter only (Lean: QCore.GnuBuiltinReader). The census reads all four members as agreeing in all 168 units; the reader change alone moves 0 of 13,101 manifest census rows and leaves all five artifacts byte-identical. vsnprintf and vprintf are declared in libc/stdio.qcore (vfprintf, vsprintf agree but are never called); stage 3 removes their 26 callee leaves and adds 1, no function moves. The va_start/va_end half is registered as W44-VA-START-END-BUILTINS. docs/reports/w44-libc-residuals/README.md.

entry.title: 1,179 printf-family call sites exchange their uncontracted-callee leaf for the declared-tail refusal; 1,081 are librdkafka's RD_UT_* macros, and admitting them would move no function
entry.why: Card W43-LIBC-PRINTF-FAMILY's arbiter removed 2,212 `call to uncontracted function` leaves of printf/fprintf/snprintf/sprintf and added 1,179 `arguments beyond the declared parameters of X are outside the resource projection` leaves in 253 functions (fprintf 1,093, snprintf 78, printf 8), the shape MK-PRINT-TAIL-ACTUALS measured for mk_print. `resource_variadic_data_tail()` admits nothing on its own; `variadic_nested::tail_arguments_are_data_with_nested` refuses every non-empty tail when the function's typed declaration facts are unreadable (`FunctionTypes::is_readable`, the total-or-reject local reader), and otherwise refuses a tail name the C02-P closure may bind. 1,081 of the 1,179 leaves are on librdkafka `RDUT:` macro lines (`fprintf(stderr, "RDUT: …", __FILE__, __LINE__, __FUNCTION__)`). Measured causes: 10 leaves have literal-only tails, so the only premise that can refuse them is unreadable typed facts; a gateway probe of `unittest_rd_crc32c` (docs/reports/w43-libc-printf-family/probe/) keeps all five of its tail refusals with `__FUNCTION__` rewritten to a string literal, so that function too is refused on readability, not on a name; the other leaves are not decided between the two premises. Bound: over the AFTER run, NO non-Safe function's remaining leaves are all family tail refusals or nested-call refusals this card added (exchange.json), so no admission of tail actuals could move a function by itself. The card therefore did not widen the rule. Discharge condition: either (a) a readability-independent admission of tail actuals that are only literals or C11 6.4.2.2 predefined identifiers (`__func__`, and the GNU `__FUNCTION__`), with matching audited Lean and its own attribution class, or a repair of the local declaration reader for the RD_UT bodies, re-measured; or acceptance of this as a measured leaf-only boundary.

ground: Discharged by its condition (a): a readability-independent admission of tail actuals that are only literals or C11 6.4.2.2 predefined identifiers, with matching audited Lean (QCore.LiteralTailActual) and its own attribution class. Card W44-LIBC-RESIDUALS' T6 admits such an actual whatever the function's typed declarations or C02-P's closure say (the closure had marked every literal risky in functions that pass one to __assert_fail). Measured first: no function could move. Stage 1: 974 of the 1,200 tail refusals removed (967 literal-only tails, 6 literal actuals beside declared scalars, 1 statement spanning lines), 0 added, 0 function moves, leak 271. The 226 name-carrying tails left are registered as W44-TAIL-NAME-ACTUALS. docs/reports/w44-libc-residuals/README.md.

entry.title: 100 printf-family calls exchange their callee leaf for a nested-call refusal on an uncontracted inner call, led by `rd_kafka_err2str` (42)
entry.why: Card W43-LIBC-PRINTF-FAMILY's arbiter added 100 `nested call X inside a modeled call is outside the resource projection` leaves in 69 functions where a now-declared printf-family call passes another call's result in its tail: `rd_kafka_err2str` 42, `rd_kafka_msgq_len` 13, `rd_list_cnt` 9, `rd_kafka_error_string` 7, `rd_buf_len` 3, and 16 more inner callees with 1-2 each (docs/reports/w43-libc-printf-family/exchange.json). Card O04-TRACE's nested-call admission requires the inner callee's contract to be in force with borrowed parameters and a `none` result (premises N6/N7); these inner callees are uncontracted, so the refusal is the premise working. Several are custody-neutral by reading (`rd_kafka_err2str` returns a description string from static or thread-local storage, the shape `gai_strerror` was declared for), but 17 of the 21 are corpus-defined bodies whose lever is a validated W4 summary or their own read declaration; `strerror` and `getpid` are undeclared libc (quirin-provider-libc's placement), `sasl_errstring` is Cyrus SASL, and the one `strlen` site is declared and refused on another nested-call premise, and no function is blocked only by these refusals. Discharge condition: declare or summarise the inner callees (each with its own reading and attribution), or accept the refusals as a measured boundary.

ground: Measured at card W44-LIBC-RESIDUALS' base as 89 leaves in 62 functions. Its libc half is discharged: strerror, the one libc inner callee a printf-family tail passes whole, is declared in libc/errno.qcore (resource_return_none(), the gai_strerror precedent) and its 2 nested leaves are removed (stage 4); getpid agrees in 137 units but both of its sites are `(long) getpid()`, which premise N4 refuses, so it is not declared. The remaining 87 (58 whole-argument corpus-defined inner callees, 28 inner calls inside a larger expression, 1 Cyrus SASL) are re-registered with their premises as W44-PRINTF-NESTED-INNER-CALLEES. docs/reports/w44-libc-residuals/README.md.
